response.courseDescription: 402 Applied Meteorology Atmospheric physical behavior across spatial scales linking concepts of meteorological phenomena to engineering design principles. Credit not granted for both CE 402 and CE 502. Cooperative: Open to UI degree-seeking students.
response.coursePrerequisites: MATH 172 or 182; 4 credits of PHYSICS 201, or PHYSICS 201 and 211, or PHYSICS 205; admitted to any major.
